info.description: Reusable campaign message template. Rutba-MTA does not keep a template library (FUNCTION.md: 'reusable saved template library -> caller app'), so this is the store; templates are rendered here and passed inline to /v1/send/batch.

folder.description: Flat folder label for grouping in the studio, as RTMPLT did (FLDID).

body_html.description: Inlined-CSS HTML produced by the GrapesJS studio (gjs-get-inlined-html). This is what ships to the MTA.

body_text.description: Plain-text alternative. Also the body for the sms/whatsapp channels.

design_json.description: GrapesJS editor state, so the design stays re-editable. Never sent to the MTA.

merge_keys.description: Merge keys this template needs, e.g. ['first_name','company']. Extracted from the body on save and validated against the audience mapping in the composer.

append_utm.description: Append the campaign's UTM parameters to outbound links at render time (RTMPLT's APPEND_IN_LINKS).
